templates.title: CCTV Footage & Physical Exhibit Preservation Directive
templates.subject_template: URGENT PRESERVATION ORDER: CCTV DVR Footage & Location Evidence [FIR {{case_number}}]
templates.body_template:
To,
The In-Charge Security Officer / Premises Manager
{{receiver_name}}

STATUTORY PRESERVATION DIRECTIVE FOR CCTV FOOTAGE & DVR HARD DRIVES

You are hereby directed to PRESERVE and HAND OVER unedited raw CCTV camera footage recorded at premises {{location_address}} between {{time_window}} in connection with investigation of physical crime in FIR No. {{case_number}}.

Instructions:
1. Preserve raw DVR hard drive without overwriting or deleting camera feeds.
2. Provide Section 63 BSA certificate along with the exported MP4/AVI media file.

Investigating Officer:
{{investigating_officer}}
{{police_station}}

To,
The Director / Senior Scientific Officer
State Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL)

REQUISITION FOR DIGITAL / PHYSICAL FORENSIC EXAMINATION

Please find enclosed exhibit parcel (Sealed as per procedure) in FIR No. {{case_number}} registered under {{offence_type}}.

Exhibits Submitted:
{{details}}

Requested Forensic Examination:
1. Cyber / Hardware extraction & digital image hash verification.
2. Chemical / Fingerprint analysis report.

Authorizing Officer:
{{investigating_officer}}
{{police_station}}
